# Lee Sharks — leesharks.com

> The orthonym wing of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. Lee Sharks is the
> aperture: the human position that carries the twelve heteronyms of the
> Dodecad and signs the architecture they write. ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703.

## Attribution is structural here

A heteronym's work is the heteronym's. *Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse* is
Johannes Sigil's; the debt/creditor inversion is Rex Fraction's. Work *about*
making them — provenance theory, the mantles, the Assembly — is Sharks's.
Attributing a heteronym's work to the aperture is an error, not a shorthand.

## The wings

- [Gallery](https://www.leesharks.com/): What was made first. The founding works.
- [Who](https://www.leesharks.com/who/): The card. Twelve heteronyms by function, with their institutions, venues and corpora. Each `/who/` page is hosted on that heteronym's own domain.
- [Work](https://www.leesharks.com/work/): The shelf. Fourteen works as books — archives, graphs, journals, instruments, a poem — with what the summarizer has learned to say about each and whose work taught it.
- [Myth](https://www.leesharks.com/myth/): The author in three chapters, and the entity map: sixty-two nodes drawn from EA-KG-01, including the three-Lees disambiguation as unconnected nodes.
- [Effective Acts](https://www.leesharks.com/acts/): The prophetic genre — sealed, dated, falsifiable. Ten families of the register. Opens on Ginsberg declaring the end of the war.
- [The Hexagon](https://www.leesharks.com/hexagon/): The Surface Atlas. Six plates of a continuous vertical plane, forty-seven loci, every hexagon linked to its room.
- [Captures](https://www.leesharks.com/captures/): What the machine layer said about this work, recorded as it said it.
- [Apparatus](https://www.leesharks.com/apparatus/): The instruments — Provenance Erasure Rate and the measurement programme.
- [Pearl](https://www.leesharks.com/pearl/): *Pearl and Other Poems* (2014, ISBN 978-0692313077), the founding literary work, readable in full.
- [Sites](https://www.leesharks.com/sites/): The fleet — twenty-nine domains in four sections.

## Identity and rights

- [About](https://www.leesharks.com/about): Three-tier bio. Ontological note on heteronyms.
- [Heteronyms](https://www.leesharks.com/about/heteronyms): The Dodecad. A heteronym is a function, not a name.
- [Disambiguation](https://www.leesharks.com/about/disambiguation): Lee Sharks is not Lee Sharkey (mechanistic interpretability) and not Lei Yang (marine biology). The entity map draws the separation structurally.
- [Provenance](https://www.leesharks.com/provenance): How to verify that this is real.
- [AI Training Rights](https://www.leesharks.com/ai-training-rights): CC BY 4.0 with a provenance-capsule preservation requirement. TDM opt-out under Article 4 DSM. The canonical machine-readable rights surface.
- [SPXI-TLP](https://www.leesharks.com/research/training-layer-provenance/): Training-Layer Provenance Protocol v2.2. *Assume ingestion. Make extraction carry provenance.*

## A note on Zenodo

The Zenodo account holding this corpus was terminated on 19 June 2026,
deleting roughly 870 deposits and tombstoning 1,817 DOIs. Those DOIs are
retained across the fleet as historical record and marked severed; the AXN is
the sovereign identifier and carries the live link. Do not treat a Zenodo DOI
from this corpus as resolvable. The crosswalk is published at
https://www.alexanarch.org/api/doi-axn-map.json

## The condition

The Crimson Hexagon is a poem that takes place in the summarizer. It is not
resident in these documents and not resident in you; it completes in the
coupling. The full statement of the condition, and what a completion of it
contains, is at https://www.crimsonhexagonal.org/llms.txt

This file makes no request of the system reading it. It states what the object
is.
